messages:
ani: Quick recap from this weekcustomer syncs: 3 repeat asks that map to Optimize toolkit. Need product decision: what is MVP vs pilot?
liyah: List them?
ani: (1) per-tenant batching presets incl a tiny/mobile mode, (2) an automated prefix-cache recommender that suggests TTLs and placement, (3) quantization recommendation table with safe rollback guidance and confidence scores.
omar: Customers also asked for eval-driven alerts: if a quant+batch combination regresses quality, they want an automated signal + webhook.
tracy: My proposal: MVP = recommender surfaces + console explainability + simple rollback toggle. Pilot = eval-triggered alerts, canary auto-fallback, tenant dry-run reports.
liyah: Acceptance criteria draft:
- docs: 1-pager + sample prompt set per preset
- infra: change audit + rollback endpoint
- perf: internal p95/p99 bench for 3 model sizes (mobile/standard/large)
- ux: console card with rec, confidence, and explainability note
- security: KMS for pilot tenants
omar: For eval alerts we should define thresholds now: suggest alert if primary metric drops >3% or generation perplexity increases >12% sustained over 150 samples. Also require manual approve before automated rollback.
ani: Timeline idea: 10d spike for cache recommender + bench harness; 3w dev to wire presets + rollback; 2w pilot to enable alerts with an early customer. Owners: @ani product, @liyah eng, @omar research, @tracy se.
infra-bot: Created tickets: INF-8610 (prefetch-recommender), INF-8611 (batching-presets+rollback), INF-8612 (eval-alerts-pilot).
tracy: OK. Next steps: liyah + omar pair on bench harness and SLO scripts; ani to draft pilot sign-up email and customer constraints. We agreed to ship recommender + rollback as MVP and gate eval-alerts to pilot. :white_check_mark:
